caveat: All figures are from one Apple M5 laptop (16GB) running local runs; Arm 0 on CPU, Arms 1-4 on Apple GPU (MPS/MLX). Not comparable to server/GPU deployments. Inference memory was NOT MEASURED for any arm. Arm 5 (frontier API) not evaluated.

arm0_tfidf_logreg.hardware: Apple M5 MacBook Pro (local CPU, scikit-learn)

arm1_distilbert.latency_note: MEASURED, median across 3 full-regime seeds; 50 single-request calls each
arm1_distilbert.throughput_note: MEASURED, batch size 32, median of 3 seeds
arm1_distilbert.train_note: MEASURED wall-clock per seed; seeds 0 and 2 inflated by macOS sleep (docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md EXP-005 gives corrected active-compute ESTIMATES of ~7.3-7.7ks per seed)
arm1_distilbert.model_footprint: distilbert-base-uncased pretrained snapshot ~256MB on disk (MEASURED with du; fine-tuned checkpoint not persisted)

arm2_llm_naive.hardware: macOS-27.0-arm64-arm-64bit device=mps (Apple M5, local $0-cost run, mlx-lm)

arm3_llm_engineered.hardware: macOS-27.0-arm64-arm-64bit device=mps (Apple M5, local $0-cost run, mlx-lm)

arm4_qlora.hardware: macOS-27.2-arm64-arm-64bit device=mps (Apple M5, local $0-cost run, mlx-lm QLoRA)
arm4_qlora.latency_note: MEASURED, 500 sequential generations, full-regime seed-0 adapter, test-ID subset
arm4_qlora.train_note: MEASURED wall-clock (24.4h), inflated by macOS sleep; ~11.9h is an ESTIMATE of step time from the logged It/sec (681-iteration reports, mean 0.319 it/s), series in reports/results/arm4/progress_rates_regime_full_seed0.json
arm4_qlora.peak_train_memory_gb: 4.399-6.05 (MEASURED range over all 10 Arm 4 training runs; full regime 4.399)
arm4_qlora.model_footprint: base ~839MB + LoRA adapter 36,971,628 bytes (~37MB) (MEASURED file size)

hypothetical_compute_hours_per_million_r.method: 1e6 / throughput_per_sec / 3600, using each arm's measured (Arms 0/1, batched) or derived (Arms 2-4, sequential unbatched) throughput. Batched LLM serving was not measured, so Arm 2-4 values are a single-stream upper bound on this laptop.
